text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe didn't seem to be feeling 
well, so I decided to let her rest in the 
infirmary.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
I'm sorry for worrying you... I'll do my 
best to get back in shape... as soon as I 
can...

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Well then————

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: "Is this... a dream...?"

――And thus did you launch a shadow into 
the sky! Welcome and good night! Manhattan 
Cafe, my friend!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: …………What about you?

I am what you portray. A film strip cut by 
someone? The moon that deep-sea fish 
dreamed of! In other words, a black 
horizon—

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Name broken, yet what flashes is... call 
it wonder! Guten Tag? Arche! Record!

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
...Wonder-san, is it? She certainly has... 
a rather unique presence...

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Tonight, in place of "thank you for the 
meal," shall I reveal to you the hidden 
incantation of the pod of whales?

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Is there something you want to tell me?

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
――The halo drawn by your eyes is a sweet 
poison. ――The whisper of its nectar 
reveals the contours of night. ――And thus, 
the shadow becomes us.

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
With black as the canvas. May tomorrow and 
summer be as well. As you speak, caress, 
and cherish it, bestow upon it a name.

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
We are footsteps. A sudden shower. What 
makes one turn. A concluding word. A brief 
patch of clear sky.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: The pleasure is all mine... Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Thanks to all of you... I don't have to 
feel alone in this world anymore...

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us dedicate baby's breath to the aged 
rat! Fill the speaking tube to the stars 
with boundless distant thunder!

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe-kun. The sewn-shut eyes 
shall open. The new moon has ended—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —A strange dream.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu. My body feels so light somehow...

After having an indescribable dream, 
Manhattan Cafe left the nurse's office 
feeling thoroughly refreshed in both body 
and mind.

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
――Your legs are a hammer crushing hearts 
on the stairs. ――Where is the window? 
None. This is sugar. ――What is fitting is 
a burned, festering night sea.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
Let us step forth into the park of deep 
black glass. In the melting forest, twin 
golden stars face the guillotine.

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
"Come. Come here. Sit there. Let's gaze 
into the well as we scrape the canvas."

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
See, it's cracking open. It's watching, 
it's fragrant. Crawling along your 
fingers, the boundaries stew together—

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, that's, no. I don't... want to go 
that way...!

text_block_list.name: Wonder
text_block_list.text:
A door of mirrors, a chair of chains, a 
maze of flesh, a lonely crown. A starving, 
laughing lady licks out the eyes of a 
headless cat!

text_block_list.name: Chorus of Eerie Voices
text_block_list.text:
Peeling, peeling, peeling, peeling, 
peeling, peeling Peeling, peeling, 
peeling, peeling, peeling, peeling 
Peeling, peeling, peeling, peeling, 
peeling――――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: Someone――

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: —Ghk.

text_block_list.name: Manhattan Cafe
text_block_list.text: ......What an unpleasant dream.

Perhaps due to bad dreams, Manhattan Cafe 
was unable to get enough rest...
